The single long ink incipit line runs to the gutter. The interlinear '(sic)' and the acute-like stroke above are present. The 'Pūrvokta' segment is heavily inked. Several diacritic and form readings remain uncertain: anusvāra rendering (ṃ vs ṁ), the 'Śravaṇena/Śravánena' form, and the final verb, which may be written with doubled j ('visarjjayet'). The left margin of fol. 109 shows this same line's end because the images overlap; it is not a separate text.
